compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Peter enters the courtyard through another disciple, answers questions at the door and fire, and denies again before the rooster crows.
observations.label: At the door and the fire

observations.body: The passage presents Entering, questioning, and three denials as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Entering, questioning, and three denials

observations.body: The passage places Peter beside Entering, questioning, and three denials.
observations.label: Peter

payload.posture: Read John 18:15–27 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states peter enters the courtyard through another disciple, answers questions at the door and fire, and denies again before the rooster crows. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
payload.title: At the door and the fire
